Having only seen this online.. finally seeing it in person absolutely blew my mind🤯 📍This is Going to the Sun Road in Glacier National Park, Montana. 🚗 It’s the only road that crosses Glacier National Park east to west, taking you from lush forest to alpine tundra in under 50 miles. 🌄The road climbs up to 6,646 feet at Logan Pass, with epic views of glacier-carved valleys, alpine lakes, waterfalls, and wildflower meadows. You also have a huge opportunity to see a variety of animals. We saw 2 bears, several mountain goats, bighorn sheep and deer. 🎟 If you are arriving in season between 7:00 am - 3:00 pm you will need a timed entry pass that you can secure online. However, if you arrive before 7 or after 3 you are free to just go! I highly recommend arriving earlier for sunrise - or even doing it for sunset.  ⏰If you don’t plan on stopping, the drive will take about 2 hours from the west entrance to the east entrance, but I highly recommend getting out along the way to explore. FAA Says Airport Only Had One Controller At Time Of Collision #usa #america  The FAA says the helicopter and plane collided because there weren’t enough Air Traffic Controllers. Reagan National was operating with one controller who had to manage all air traffic in the area & that tower typically has at least two controllers for the level of traffic the area was under at the time. So the controller who was handling helicopters was also handling landings and departures of planes. This comes after Trump froze the hiring of Air Traffic Controllers and offered them buy outs to leave their jobs earlier this week. He also reportedly fired hundreds of critical staff & allowed Elon to seemingly push the head of the FAA out. Just this past summer, the FAA released a report that it needed 3,000 more air traffic controllers nationally. This morning Trump blamed DEI DEI DEI. But Trump is doubling down on this lie with him now signing a Presidential memorandum ordering competence over DEI.
